cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle tonight's plans. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay with you tonight. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide the invitation to make me choose you?

reason: A offers company around B first motive and progressively exposes A own jealousy to draw out the deeper reason; name invitation in A5 so it cannot drift to the photos.
